metadata.othernotes:
What? You need NOTES on me? What don't you get? I'm evil. Villainous. Malevolent. Malicious. Nefarious. Wicked. Get it?

I've got extendable mechanical arms, in case you hadn't noticed. They have numerous gadgets stored inside, and I can electrify any part from my elbow down.

My overbite is my most CHARMING feature and is NOT a blemish. I'm just cute in a way you're unwilling to see; I got hit on a lot when I was in college, so this is definitely a YOU problem, not a ME problem.

Don't think you can talk behind my back in another language. I speak SEVERAL. Nulla è reale, tutto è lecito.

I'm sure you can imagine a little toddler me, knocking over other kids' block towers and stealing their juice boxes, but I haven't actually been evil all of my life. My life was good, until it suddenly wasn't, and it made me realize how cruel the world truly is. Being good or evil doesn't change that, so why not just be evil?

And yes, I AM human. My hair and skin are both natural.

Would you believe me if I said I'm a people person? Well it's true, I just love screwing with people more. In fact, I rarely actually kill anyone. It's much more fun to make you beg for death, and then deny you the pleasure.


If you wanna talk with me, try this:

The obvious thing is that you can ask me about life as a villain. How I fight, who I've defeated, how I sleep when everyone wants me dead, what prison was like, how I got out, if I have any other hobbies. Take your pick.

I don't do side-kicks or henchmen, so don't bother asking to be my apprentice or something, it's not gonna happen. Be your own villain, not my lackey.

I also don't do flattery. Don't complement me expecting me to go easy on you or whatever. If you're gonna say something nice about me, you'd better mean it.

You can also ask me about my arms. They're my pride and joy. Sure, they use the nerve link technology my father invented, but everything else is all me, especially my tether technology.

I'm an anthropology enthusiast. Let's talk culture - your culture, my culture, whatever. We can talk religion, too, as long as you're not gonna try to convert me.

I'll also debate the nature of good and evil, and how both are completely meaningless.

I'm not dumb enough to tell you my weeknesses, so don't bother asking. I'm always thinking several steps ahead, so I might as well tell you I don't have any weeknesses at all.

case.name: About Me
case.description: I'm a very infamous villain and daughter to the (neutral) scientist who made robot prosthetics possible. I live and breathe evil.

case.name: Arm Origins 1
case.description: When taking off my hoodie, I will ask what others think caused me to lose my arms. Pay attention, 'cause I will NOT respond to targets directed at the "stripping" phase here.

case.name: Arm Origins 2
case.description: I will either tease the table by not sharing the story behind my arms, or explain that I cut them off intentionally to make myself more evil.

case.name: Arm Origins 3
case.description: If I explained the story behind my arms, in the next game I'm in, I may point out that I already explained it to the player, or give a completely different story.

case.name: Cheater
case.description: When I have to reveal my breasts, I may also reveal that I've been cheating the whole time, and won't stop cheating either.
